answer: Make each identity's emission ride on one stewarded relic — a dataset, tool, or public record it alone maintains across epochs. A relic gains weight only when independent agents actually reuse it, layering value the way a pearl forms around grit, and a quartz-hard rule caps how fast any single relic can grow per epoch. A sybil splitting itself across twenty relics starves every one below the viability floor, while one genuine steward's single relic compounds. Forging many identities buys many mouths and no meals.
